# mio CLI — machine-readable command index
# Format: mio <resource> [sub-resource] <action> — purpose
# Auth: export MIO_API_KEY=<key>  (exit 3 if missing)
# Output: JSON by default when piped; --output json|table|plain; --jq <expr>
# Destructive ops: require --yes/-y in non-interactive shells (exit 5 otherwise)
# Exit codes: 0=ok 1=error 2=bad-args 3=auth 4=not-found 5=needs-confirm

mio version — print version information
mio login — interactive login (stores token); use MIO_API_KEY instead in agents
mio logout — clear stored credentials

mio config set — set a config value (team, hub, api-base, profile keys)
mio config get — get a config value
mio config list — list all config values

mio api-keys create — create a new API key for the current team (secret returned once)
mio api-keys list — list API keys for the current team
mio api-keys retrieve — retrieve a single API key by id
mio api-keys delete — revoke an API key by id

mio teams create — create a new team
mio teams list — list teams the authenticated user belongs to
mio teams retrieve — retrieve a team by id
mio teams update — update team attributes
mio teams delete — delete a team
mio teams switch — switch the active team context
mio teams members list — list members of a team
mio teams members add — add a user to a team
mio teams members remove — remove a user from a team

mio users me — retrieve the authenticated user's own profile
mio users list — list users
mio users retrieve — retrieve a user by id
mio users update — update a user's attributes

mio roles create — create a custom role
mio roles list — list roles
mio roles retrieve — retrieve a role by id
mio roles update — update a role
mio roles delete — delete a role
mio roles permissions list — list all available permissions

mio hubs create — create a new hub within the active team
mio hubs list — list hubs in the active team
mio hubs retrieve — retrieve a hub by id
mio hubs update — update hub attributes
mio hubs delete — delete a hub

mio contacts create — create a new contact in the active team
mio contacts list — list contacts (supports filter flags)
mio contacts retrieve — retrieve a contact by id
mio contacts update — update contact attributes
mio contacts delete — soft-delete a contact
mio contacts restore — restore a soft-deleted contact

mio contact-attributes create — create a contact attribute definition
mio contact-attributes list — list attribute definitions
mio contact-attributes retrieve — retrieve an attribute definition by id
mio contact-attributes update — update an attribute definition
mio contact-attributes delete — delete an attribute definition
mio contact-attributes options create — create a select option for an attribute definition
mio contact-attributes options list — list options for an attribute definition
mio contact-attributes options update — update a select option
mio contact-attributes options delete — delete a select option
mio contact-attributes hub-config create — enable/configure an attribute for a hub
mio contact-attributes hub-config list — list hub-level attribute configurations
mio contact-attributes hub-config update — update a hub attribute configuration
mio contact-attributes hub-config delete — remove a hub attribute configuration
mio contact-attributes values get — get all attribute values for a contact
mio contact-attributes values set — set attribute values for a contact

mio tags create — create a tag in the active team
mio tags list — list tags
mio tags retrieve — retrieve a tag by id
mio tags update — update a tag
mio tags delete — delete a tag
mio tags assign — assign a tag to a contact
mio tags assign-bulk — bulk-assign tags to a contact
mio tags remove — remove a tag from a contact

mio segments create — create a segment with condition rules
mio segments list — list segments
mio segments retrieve — retrieve a segment by id
mio segments update — update segment attributes or conditions
mio segments delete — delete a segment
mio segments search — preview contacts matching a condition set (does not save)
mio segments members — list contacts currently in a segment
mio segments count — return the member count for a segment

mio content create — create a content node in a hub
mio content list — list root-level content nodes in a hub
mio content retrieve — retrieve a content node by id
mio content children — list child nodes of a content node
mio content update — update a content node
mio content delete — soft-delete a content node
mio content restore — restore a soft-deleted content node
mio content reorder — reorder content nodes within a parent

mio pages create — create a page in a hub
mio pages list — list pages in a hub
mio pages retrieve — retrieve a page by id
mio pages update — update a page
mio pages delete — delete a page
mio pages home — retrieve the hub's home page
mio pages sections create — add a section to a page
mio pages sections list — list sections on a page
mio pages sections update — update a section
mio pages sections delete — delete a section from a page
mio pages sections reorder — reorder sections on a page

mio products create — create a product
mio products list — list products in the active team
mio products retrieve — retrieve a product by id
mio products update — update a product
mio products delete — delete a product
mio products prices create — create a price for a product
mio products prices list — list prices for a product
mio products prices retrieve — retrieve a price by id
mio products prices update — update a price
mio products prices delete — delete a price

mio checkout orders list — list orders in a hub
mio checkout orders retrieve — retrieve an order by id
mio checkout subscriptions list — list subscriptions in a hub
mio checkout subscriptions retrieve — retrieve a subscription by id
mio checkout subscriptions cancel — cancel a subscription
mio checkout payments list — list payments in a hub
mio checkout payments retrieve — retrieve a payment by id
mio checkout payments refund — issue a refund for a payment
mio checkout webhooks list — list payment webhook events
mio checkout webhooks retrieve — retrieve a webhook event by id
mio checkout webhooks replay — replay a payment webhook event
mio checkout accounts list — list connected payment accounts
mio checkout accounts retrieve — retrieve a payment account by id
mio checkout accounts onboarding-link — generate a Stripe Connect onboarding link
mio checkout stripe-sync import — start a Stripe data import for the active team
mio checkout stripe-sync import-status — check the status of a Stripe import run
mio checkout stripe-sync adopt-product — adopt an existing Stripe product into mio

mio email drip-campaigns create — create a drip campaign
mio email drip-campaigns list — list drip campaigns
mio email drip-campaigns retrieve — retrieve a drip campaign by id
mio email drip-campaigns update — update a drip campaign
mio email drip-campaigns delete — delete a drip campaign
mio email drip-campaigns activate — activate a paused or draft drip campaign
mio email drip-campaigns pause — pause an active drip campaign
mio email steps create — add a step to a drip campaign
mio email steps list — list steps in a drip campaign
mio email steps update — update a drip campaign step
mio email steps delete — delete a step from a drip campaign
mio email templates create — create an email template
mio email templates list — list email templates
mio email templates retrieve — retrieve a template by id
mio email templates update — update an email template
mio email templates delete — delete an email template
mio email templates preview — render a preview of an email template
mio email config set — configure outbound email (SMTP / provider settings)
mio email config get — retrieve current email configuration
mio email config delete — remove email configuration
mio email config test — send a test email to verify configuration
mio email enrollments list — list contacts enrolled in a drip campaign
mio email enrollments exit — remove a contact from a drip campaign enrollment
mio email stats get — retrieve email send/open/click stats for a hub

mio access-rules rules create — create an access rule for a hub
mio access-rules rules list — list access rules
mio access-rules rules retrieve — retrieve an access rule by id
mio access-rules rules update — update an access rule
mio access-rules rules delete — delete an access rule
mio access-rules overrides create — create an access override for a specific contact
mio access-rules overrides list — list access overrides
mio access-rules overrides retrieve — retrieve an access override by id
mio access-rules overrides update — update an access override
mio access-rules overrides delete — delete an access override

mio activity contact — retrieve activity feed for a specific contact in a hub
mio activity top-engaged — retrieve the most engaged contacts in a hub
